text:
support-alex: heads-up — AcmeMaps (acmemap-prod) reporting repeated 429s and 2–4s tail latencies during today's 08:00 ramp. Customer says autoscaling didn't react fast enough.

eng-runtime-maya: can you paste the customer request ids / sample logs? any 5xx or cloud errors?

support-alex: sample response body showed 429 with message 'queued: capacity unavailable', then a handful of 502s. Customer provided a short repro: run our loadtest against their route (api.acmemap.com/v1/generate) with 120 concurrent connections ramping to 250 qps over 90s.

customer-success-amy: customer confirms they didn't change config. They're on Dedicated with minReplicas=2, maxReplicas=50. They expected warm pool to absorb the morning spike.

sre-jonathan: checked cluster events and our infra metrics — new pods were scheduled but node provisioning lagged. GCE API returned RATE_EXCEEDED and later QUOTA_EXCEEDED for GPUs. Node create time ~110s in that window. Kube events include 'FailedCreatePod: 0/3 nodes are available: Insufficient gpu.count'.

eng-platform-lee: also seeing preflight holdoff kicking in — our preflight queue held requests for that customer for ~50s before returning 429. Warm pool size for acmemap-prod was 0 (they had disabled warm pool to save cost). So two things: no warm containers + cloud quota/rate limits.

eng-runtime-maya: summary: scale-up path = (1) request -> preflight -> decide to scale -> provision node -> schedule pod -> pod init -> serve. If node creation > request TTL + preflight timeout, client gets 429/queue.

support-alex: customer attached screenshots of console showing a sea of queued requests and repeated 429s between 08:02:15 and 08:04:45. They want mitigation now.

product-sarah: short-term mitigation options: bump minReplicas for acmemap-prod, temporarily enable warm pool size > 0, or enable burst capacity (if available). Need ops ok on temporary override.

sre-jonathan: I propose: 1) temporarily set minReplicas=6 for acmemap-prod, 2) enable warm pool of 3 warmed workers, 3) request quota bump with cloud ops. Steps I can run now.

support-alex: customer agreed to temporary bump. They prefer rollback after peak.

eng-platform-lee: creating change now. deploy-bot: rollouts/override/acmemap-prod -> set minReplicas=6, warmPool=3 (temp). Link: https://console.internal/release/rollout/9876

deploy-bot: rollout started for acmemap-prod override (pr 4821). Canary to 10% -> 100% in 2m if no errors. :rocket:

eng-runtime-maya: adding repro for infra: run this locally to reproduce the behavior (use with caution):

```
# simple ramp script
for i in {1..120}; do
  ab -n 10000 -c 250 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.acmemap.com/v1/generate
done
```

This will show queued requests then 429s when warm pool is zero and node provisioning is slow.

sre-jonathan: post-change summary: after minReplicas/warmPool bump traffic ramp at 08:35 showed no 429s and tail P95 reduced from 3.9s -> 0.45s. Node provisioning still slow but warm pool handled steady state.

support-alex: customer confirmed improved UX and asked for root-cause analysis and long-term fix.

eng-platform-lee: long-term items: (a) detect customers with warm_pool=0 + low minReplicas and auto-suggest warm pool or burst policy when traffic shows rapid ramps, (b) surface cloud quota/rate errors to alerting (we had them in infra logs but not surfaced to product), (c) consider prewarming for scheduled traffic windows.

product-sarah: noted. I'll open a roadmap item for warm-pool auto-suggestion and an alerting ticket for cloud quota errors.

support-alex: filing customer follow-up ticket and will schedule 1:1 with AcmeMaps to discuss SLA tweaks and recommended minReplicas.

sre-jonathan: follow-up action items: 1) keep quota ticket open with cloud ops (TKT-2147), 2) verify autoscaler backoff logic and reduce preflight timeout for Dedicated where warm pool is disabled, 3) add doc snippet to run the provided repro for support teams. Assigning to eng-runtime-maya and eng-platform-lee.

eng-runtime-maya: acknowledged. I'll also instrument a metric that correlates "warm_pool_size==0 AND traffic_ramp_rate>threshold" and send alert.

support-alex: closing loop with customer today. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
